column1: 圖片、掃描頁、影片字幕裡的中文字也一起認出來（泰文和英文一定會認）。字幕是泰文加中文的影片，中文那行會留在泰文下面當翻譯。台灣的字幕選「繁體」，中國的字幕組選「簡體」。不需要就選「不辨識」，辨識會快一點。
column2: Also recognize Chinese in images, scans and video subtitles (Thai and English are always recognized). For videos with Thai and Chinese subtitles, the Chinese line stays under the Thai as a translation. Choose “Traditional” for Taiwanese subtitles, “Simplified” for mainland ones, or “Off” for faster recognition.

column1: 字典沒收錄的明星、劇名、品牌等。查詞時按「這是名字？」就能加進來，之後所有文件都會把它當成一個詞。
column2: Celebrities, show titles, brands and other names the dictionary lacks. Tap “A name?” in a lookup to add one; every document will then treat it as one word.

column1: 查詞時按「斷詞不對？」，可以把切開的字合成一個詞，或把黏在一起的詞拆開；所有文件都會照這樣斷。
column2: Tap “Split wrong?” in a lookup to join letters that were cut apart, or split words stuck together; every document will follow it.

column1: 雲端同步（Google 雲端硬碟）
文件、PDF、筆記、生字卡和設定，存在你自己的 Google 雲端硬碟裡這個 App 專用的隱藏資料夾（不會出現在你的檔案清單，App 也看不到你其他的檔案）。在另一台平板、手機或電腦打開這個 App，連結同一個 Google 帳號，兩邊就會自動合併。
column2: Documents, PDFs, notes, flashcards and settings are stored in a hidden app-only folder in your own Google Drive (it doesn't show in your file list, and the app can't see your other files). Open the app on another tablet, phone or computer and link the same Google account; both sides merge automatically.
